turns.question: Summarise the portfolio.
turns.answer: At 30 June 2026 the portfolio holds 11,035 loans with a funded balance of £1.96bn. Weighted-average current LTV is 43.2%, the weighted-average interest rate is 6.56% and the average youngest-borrower age is 71.4 years. The largest regional exposures are South East (£516.2m, 26.3%), London (£413.8m, 21.1%) and South West (£237.4m, 12.1%). By source portfolio: ALP Origination Book £1.39bn and ALP Acquired Back Book £579.4m.

turns.question: What has changed versus the prior month?
turns.answer: Funded balances increased by £18.1m during the month, primarily driven by completions in the South East. Weighted-average LTV remained broadly stable at 43.2%, while average borrower age increased slightly to 71.4 years. ALP Origination Book contributed approximately +£11.5m and ALP Acquired Back Book contributed approximately +£6.6m of the movement.

sourceNotes.note: Regional contributions sum to £18.1m against a consolidated movement of £18.1m (residual £-0).
Loans completed in 2026-06 carry £10.1m of balance, of which £5.0m is in the South East.
